messages.author: e3b82f336ca6fc43
messages.subject: mediation Analysis in lavaan
parts:
Dear everyone
 
I have a question about Mediation Analysis in lavaan. I run a model with Yuan-Bentler correction, because my data is really bad distributed.
 
Now I read in literature, that bootstrapping is best in mediation analysis. I run my model again with test = bootstrap.
 
The results do not change a lot. Modelfit is better with Yuan-Bentler, Standard Errors and regression weights are sometimes better with Yuan-Bentler and sometimes better with bootstrapping.
 
Another thing I read in literature, is that testing for significance of indirect effects is done by the Sobel test (which is not always recomended). Now I wonder, how lavaan does calculate the significance of the indirect effects. Is it the sobel test by Default?
 
thanks for your answer.
 
Xenia

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: mediation Analysis in lavaan
parts:
On 01/23/2015 04:12 PM, MüllerX wrote:
> I have a question about Mediation Analysis in lavaan. I run a model with
> Yuan-Bentler correction, because my data is really bad distributed.
> Now I read in literature, that bootstrapping is best in mediation

The bootstrapping recommendation is only meant for the indirect/total
effects (the ones defined by ":="), as it gives a better standard error
compared to the standard approach (which is the delta method, or the
so-called Sobel method).

So if you have effects defined by ":=", you can not go wrong with
bootstrapping.

Yves.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: mediation Analysis in lavaan
parts:
On 02/05/2015 03:09 PM, MüllerX wrote:
> Just two more questions:
> 1) is it also ok to run the model with yuan-bentler correction without
> bootstrapping?

For model parameters, I would say: "yes". Here is a reference:

http://www3.nd.edu/~kyuan/papers/Yuan-Hayashi-BJMSP06.pdf

For functions of model parameters (like product terms), I would go for
the bootstrap.
> 2) Is it possible to run a model, combining bootstrapping with yuan-bentler?

No. But you can run the model with yuan-bentler first, and use the
bootstrapLavaan() function afterwards.

Yves.
